name: 77437 · El Campo, TX
findings: ZIP 77437 (El Campo) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77437 (El Campo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77437 (El Campo) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
